description: This file provides a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` to manage progressive batch processing within a React component. It's used for applying work in batches (like expanding tree nodes) without blocking the UI, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout for fallback. The code defines functions, hooks, callbacks, and manages internal state related to processing progress.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that processes items in batches asynchronously, with progress callbacks and cancel functionality.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to provide progress and control functionalities for progressive batch processing.
